answer: We formalize Sybil resistance by requiring each identity to deposit a dynamic opportunity-cost bond as staking collateral, establishing a rigorous capital barrier. A subgame-perfect punishment matrix slashes this collateral if an adversarial identity plume attempts to bridge dishonest assertions across the validation garden. By combining these penalties with zero-knowledge verifiable delays, the expected utility of identity multiplication is rendered strictly negative, converging to a unique, collusion-proof Nash equilibrium.
